cutscene.speaker: NARRATOR
lines: Cold metal presses against your back.
You open your eyes to flickering lights.
The facility hums... alive, but failing.

cutscene.speaker: A.I. UNIT-04
lines: You are safe as long as you listen to me.

cutscene.speaker: NARRATOR
lines: The machine's voice follows you as you walk through the halls, soft and persuassive.

cutscene.speaker: A.I. UNIT-04
lines: Maintain the facility. Keep it stable.
